run_maml_omniglot_training: run MAML meta-learning on Omniglot with configurable n-way k-shot few-shot classification
train_inner_loop_adaptation: train a model using higher.innerloop_ctx to adapt meta-parameters via inner-loop gradient steps on support sets
test_meta_learning_accuracy: test the meta-learned model on Omniglot test tasks without fine-tuning and log accuracy
plot_training_accuracy: plot training and test accuracy curves over epochs and save to maml-accs.png
create_flatten_module: create a PyTorch Flatten module that reshapes input tensors to 2D for linear layers
